title: Sparkly magic wand
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='wand' x1='0' y1='1' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8B4513'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#D2691E'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F4A460'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='star' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFACD'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD700'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- wand stick -->
  <rect x='40' y='38' width='12' height='56' rx='6' transform='rotate(-30 46 66)' fill='url(#wand)'/>
  <!-- wand handle band -->
  <rect x='40' y='78' width='12' height='6' rx='3' transform='rotate(-30 46 81)' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <!-- star at tip -->
  <polygon points='55,10 60,26 78,28 65,39 69,56 55,46 41,56 45,39 32,28 50,26' fill='url(#star)' stroke='#FFE066' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- star inner glow -->
  <polygon points='55,18 58,28 70,29 61,36 64,47 55,40 46,47 49,36 40,29 52,28' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <polygon points='20,20 22,26 28,28 22,30 20,36 18,30 12,28 18,26' fill='#FF69B4'/>
  <polygon points='80,55 81,59 86,60 81,61 80,65 79,61 74,60 79,59' fill='#00CED1'/>
  <polygon points='15,70 16,74 21,75 16,76 15,80 14,76 9,75 14,74' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <polygon points='82,82 83,85 87,86 83,87 82,90 81,87 77,86 81,85' fill='#FF69B4'/>
  <polygon points='35,15 36,18 40,19 36,20 35,23 34,20 30,19 34,18' fill='#00CED1'/>
  <polygon points='72,70 73,73 77,74 73,75 72,78 71,75 67,74 71,73' fill='#FFA500'/>
  <!-- small dots -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='55' r='2' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='20' r='2' fill='#FF69B4'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='40' r='2' fill='#00CED1'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='45' r='2' fill='#FFA500'/>
</svg>
